description:
Role & responsibilities Key Responsibilities Infrastructure & Hardware Management: Configure, install, and maintain office laptops, desktops, trading workstations, and servers. Provide technical support for all internal departments regarding hardware, software, and peripheral issues. [1] Trading Terminal & Network Support: Ensure uninterrupted connectivity for stock trading terminals, local area networks (LAN/WAN), Wi-Fi, and VPN systems. Coordinate with internet service providers (ISPs) and exchange connectivity vendors (NSE/BSE) to prevent downtime during market hours. Data Security & Compliance: Implement and manage data security measures, including Two-Factor Authentication (2FA) and endpoint protection. Ensure sensitive client data, financial records, and trading credentials remain secure, preventing unauthorized transfers between workstations. Maintain an up-to-date inventory of company IT assets, software licenses, and AMC (Annual Maintenance Contracts). [1] Performance Monitoring & Reporting: Monitor system speeds, server performance, and network bandwidth to optimize operational costs and efficiency. Log and report any anomalous activities, potential data breaches, or identity mismatches immediately to management. [1] 

 Preferred candidate profile Education: Bachelors degree in Computer Science, IT, BCA, B.Sc. (IT/Computer Science), or Diploma in Hardware & Networking. Experience: 1 to 3 years of hands-on experience in IT support, preferably within the BFSI, fintech, or stock broking sector. Technical Skills: Strong knowledge of Windows and Linux/Ubuntu desktop and server operating systems. Understanding of trading network setups, firewalls, routers, switches, and remote desktop tools. Familiarity with basic stock broking compliance or system audit requirements is a strong plus. [1] Soft Skills: Good problem-solving and troubleshooting abilities under high-pressure market hours. Clear communication skills to assist non-technical staff.
